card.name: "of" after 1% in NSAID ulcer warning
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after a percentage ("approximately 1%") in the NSAID warning about upper GI ulcers, bleeding or perforation. It is tied to this repeated label sentence.

modes.label: NSAID GI risk sentence
modes.description: The word "of" after "approximately 1%" in the sentence on upper GI ulcers, gross bleeding or perforation caused by NSAIDs.
modes.example: Upper GI ulcers, gross bleeding, or perforation caused by NSAIDs occurred in approximately 1%<< of>> patients treated for 3-6 months

card.plain: It fires on the "of" in the standard NSAID warning that about 1% of patients had ulcers or bleeding.
